data.name: Anay
data.gender_notes: Anay is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Anay means 'Breath' or 'Life'. In Hindu mythology, Anay is the Vedic god of breath, wind, and the sky. He is also considered a form of the god Vayu and the god of life. The name Anay carries the meaning “Breath, Life” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anay usually hope their child will grow to embody breath, life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the connection between life and breath.
data.etymology: Anay belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Breath, Life.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anay total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
